question: Which five machines used the most energy last quarter?
text:
These are the five machines that used the most energy last quarter (Q3 2026, 1 July to 30 September), going by each machine's own meter:

| Rank | Machine | Line / Department | Consumption (kWh) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Oven 1 (mach_c1_1) | Painting line 1 | 199,186 |
| 2 | Press 5 (mach_a3_2) | Stamping line 3 | 157,659 |
| 3 | Press 4 (mach_a3_1) | Stamping line 3 | 157,224 |
| 4 | Oven 2 (mach_c2_1) | Painting line 2 | 138,316 |
| 5 | Press 3 (mach_a2_1) | Stamping line 2 | 113,498 |

- The two painting ovens and three stamping presses make up the top five. Welder 3 (mach_b2_1) comes next at 92,008 kWh.
- Press 4 and Press 5 used almost the same amount, about 435 kWh apart.
- The query returned all 26 machines. I picked the top five from that list.
sql: SELECT r.meter_id AS meter_id, sum(r.kwh) AS value FROM reading r WHERE r.meter_id IN ? AND r.local_date >= ? AND r.local_date < ? GROUP BY r.meter_id ORDER BY r.meter_id
